prior_exposure_basis.description: COVID-presence outcomes for the same 10 Microsoft observations were already present in repository artifacts before the v1 rule/scanner freeze.

base_rule.reuse: filing set, primary-document scope, exclusions, FilingLag integrity checks, and primary term set are reused as historical base logic; v1 remains unchanged.

data_scope.filings: the same 10 Microsoft accessions in covid_rule_v1.json
data_scope.fetch_rule: download each primary filing document once and apply every frozen term set to the same bytes

S1.label: primary plus compact COVID19, plural coronavirus, and SARS-CoV-2 forms

S2.label: S1 without corona to reduce non-disease ambiguity such as Corona beer

binary_rule: For each term set separately: covid_present = 1 iff that term set has match_count > 0 in the normalized primary-document text; otherwise 0.
normalization: HTMLParser text extraction; exclude script/style/head/ix:hidden; collapse whitespace; regex IGNORECASE. No stemming, semantic expansion, or section cherry-picking.

sensitivity_decision_rule.agreement_required: For each of all 10 filings, PRIMARY, S1, S2 and S3 must produce the same binary value.
sensitivity_decision_rule.q4_2019_special: If any term set produces a match in Q4-2019, FLAGGED.
sensitivity_decision_rule.assurance_ceiling: VERIFIED only after all 10 binaries agree across PRIMARY/S1/S2/S3 and Claude independently reviews the snippets.
sensitivity_decision_rule.note: The scanner itself cannot emit VERIFIED.

historical_reference.purpose: retrospective comparison only; not treated as preregistered expected outcomes

required_output.failure_record: On any execution/integrity/retrieval failure, write a partial failure JSON record to the result path before exiting non-zero.

immutability: This protocol must be reviewed before execution. After the first SEC retrieval under v1-R, changes require a new versioned retrospective protocol and must not overwrite v1-R.
v1_future_boundary: A genuinely preregistered confirmatory COVID-disclosure study with unseen filings is deferred to V1, not this POC.
